questionText: "I am learning French now," Peter said. -> Peter said that he ________ French then.
explanation: Lùi thì trong câu gián tiếp: Hiện tại tiếp diễn (am learning) lùi thành Quá khứ tiếp diễn: was learning; trạng từ 'now' chuyển thành 'then'.
ruleTip: Lùi thì: am learning -> was learning; đổi trạng từ: now -> then.

questionText: "Where are you going for your holiday?" Mary asked me. -> Mary asked me ________ for my holiday.
explanation: Trong câu hỏi gián tiếp: KHÔNG đảo ngữ, đưa về trật tự khẳng định: where + S + was going (where I was going).
ruleTip: Câu hỏi gián tiếp: KHÔNG đảo ngữ, đưa về trật tự khẳng định (where + S + was going).

questionText: "Do you speak English?" the tourist asked me. -> The tourist asked me if I ________ English.
explanation: Câu hỏi Yes/No gián tiếp: dùng if / whether + S + V(lùi thì). Hiện tại đơn 'speak' lùi thành Quá khứ đơn: spoke.
ruleTip: Câu hỏi Yes/No gián tiếp: dùng IF/WHETHER + S + V(lùi thì: spoke).

questionText: "Don't touch that bare wire!" the electrician shouted. -> The electrician warned me ________ that bare wire.
explanation: Câu mệnh lệnh phủ định gián tiếp: tell / ask / warn + O + NOT TO V-inf (not to touch).
ruleTip: Câu mệnh lệnh phủ định gián tiếp: S + warned/told + O + NOT TO V-inf.

questionText: "Why don't we go camping this weekend?" Nam said. -> Nam suggested ________ camping that weekend.
explanation: Tường thuật câu gợi ý với động từ suggest: suggest + V-ing (suggested going).
ruleTip: Cấu trúc gợi ý: suggest + V-ing (Nam suggested going camping).

questionText: The doctor suggested that he ________ smoking cigarettes immediately.
explanation: Cấu trúc giả định với suggest: suggest that + S + (should) + V-inf (should stop).
ruleTip: Cấu trúc: suggest that + S + (should) + V-inf.

questionText: "Remember to lock the front door before leaving," Mom said. -> Mom reminded me ________ the front door.
explanation: Cấu trúc nhắc nhở ai làm gì: remind sb + TO V-inf (to lock).
ruleTip: 'Remind sb to V': nhắc nhở ai làm gì.

questionText: "I will visit my grandmother tomorrow," Minh said. -> Minh said that he ________ his grandmother the following day.
explanation: Lùi thì: 'will visit' lùi thành would visit; 'tomorrow' đổi thành 'the following day'.
ruleTip: will -> would; my -> his; tomorrow -> the following day / the next day.

questionText: "You must submit the assignment today," the teacher said. -> The teacher said that we ________ the assignment that day.
explanation: Động từ 'must' khi lùi thì trong câu gián tiếp chuyển thành had to + V-inf (had to submit); 'today' chuyển thành 'that day'.
ruleTip: must lùi thì thành 'had to'; today đổi thành 'that day'.

questionText: "I'm sorry I broke your ceramic vase," Tim said to Lan. -> Tim apologized to Lan for ________ her ceramic vase.
explanation: Cấu trúc xin lỗi ai về điều gì: apologize to sb for + V-ing (breaking).
ruleTip: 'Apologize to sb for + V-ing': xin lỗi ai vì đã làm gì.

questionText: "Thank you for helping me with the project," Mai said to Nam. -> Mai thanked Nam for ________ her with the project.
explanation: Cấu trúc cảm ơn ai vì đã làm gì: thank sb for + V-ing (helping).
ruleTip: 'Thank sb for + V-ing': cảm ơn ai vì việc gì.

questionText: "Be careful or you will slip on the wet floor," he said. -> He warned me ________ on the wet floor.
explanation: Cấu trúc cảnh báo ai không làm gì: warn sb NOT TO V-inf (not to slip).
ruleTip: 'Warn sb not to V': cảnh báo ai không làm gì.

questionText: Lan ________ me that she had passed the Grade 10 entrance examination.
explanation: Khi có tân ngữ gián tiếp chỉ người ('me'), ta dùng động từ told (told me that...). 'Said' đi với 'that' mà không có tân ngữ trực tiếp theo sau.
ruleTip: 'Told + tân ngữ' (told me); 'Said that' (không có tân ngữ trực tiếp).

questionText: "Can you lend me your dictionary?" she asked. -> She asked me if I ________ lend her my dictionary.
explanation: Modal verb 'can' khi chuyển sang câu gián tiếp lùi thì thành could.
ruleTip: can lùi thì thành COULD trong câu hỏi gián tiếp.

questionText: "You stole my bicycle!" the boy shouted. -> The boy accused the man of ________ his bicycle.
explanation: Cấu trúc buộc tội ai đã làm gì: accuse sb of + V-ing (stealing).
ruleTip: 'Accuse sb of + V-ing': buộc tội ai đã làm gì.
